description: The terrestrial plane of embodied beings and physical experience
The atmospheric plane between earth and sun inhabited by munis and siddhas
The celestial heaven of the devas extending from sun to Dhruva
The plane of great saints who survive the three-world dissolution
The plane of Sanaka and other mind-born sons of Brahma
The plane of supreme austerity between Jana and Satya
The highest plane of truth where death has no dominion
Ruled by Bala the asura; three supernatural powers emerge from his yawn
Shiva dwells here with Bhavani; gold-flowing river Hataki originates here
Realm of the great devotee-king Bali to whom Vamana gave lordship
Abode of the great asura architect Maya protected by Shiva
Home of the many-hooded Nagas descended from Kadru
Abode of Daityas and Danavas; Vishnu's Sudarshana guards against them
The lowest realm of Nagas with jeweled palaces and luminous serpent hoods
